message: I was chatting with my grandkids in our family group chat the other day, and we started talking about being ready for anything, from summer storms to unexpected hiccups. It reminded me of how important it is for kids to know what to do in those situations. There’s a great resource out there that can help families talk about preparedness in a fun way. It’s a gentle reminder that being prepared can be part of our everyday conversations — and maybe a reason for a little family fun! What’s your favorite family preparedness tip?
